svg.title: Proposed, A: the fix's own tip is the release candidate
svg.desc: Main's line on the left, top to bottom. The run judges C, main's tip, and is red in size-check; it holds C as the release candidate, the local branch release-candidate. The red's fix is a branch started at C that never merges main. just land merges it into main like any task, so its tip F, the tree its reviewer approved, is on main. The candidate moves to F. The rerun on F runs the steps that were red and those whose inputs the fix changed; every other step keeps the green it had on C. Green: F is tagged release-YYYY-MM-DD, the tag is pushed and the machine refreshed. Main had the fix at its land, a later run on main descends from F, and nothing is merged back.
